name: xdbml-site
description: xDBML.org documentation site, built with VitePress

scripts.docs:dev: npm run prepare:examples && npm run prepare:playground && vitepress dev .
scripts.docs:build: npm run prepare:examples && npm run prepare:playground && vitepress build .
scripts.build:playground: cd playground && npm install && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:parser && npm run test:playground && npm run check:vsix
scripts.check: npm test && cd playground && npm run type-check && cd .. && npm run docs:build
